description: This file defines a complex query builder for a chart plugin in Apache Superset, specifically for AG Grid tables. It includes functions for inferring query modes, constructing query objects with filters, sorting, pagination, and handling external filters and cache management.

methods.name: getQueryMode
methods.description: Infers the query mode (raw or aggregate) based on form data, prioritizing explicit query_mode or presence of all_columns.

methods.name: buildQuery
methods.description: Main function that constructs a query object based on form data, handling sorting, filters, pagination, and special cases like totals and external filters.

methods.name: cachedBuildQuery
methods.description: Creates a cached version of the buildQuery function to optimize repeated query building with external filter changes.
